content.text:
**“IntelGate” can refer to a few different things**, depending on context:

1. **A political/intelligence controversy** — sometimes spelled **Intelgate** — referring to allegations that U.S. Central Command intelligence reports about ISIS/Syria/Iraq were manipulated around 2015. The term is not as widely standardized as “Watergate” or “Russiagate.” ([military-history.fandom.com](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Intelgate?utm_source=openai))

2. **A company name** — **Intelgate / インテルゲート** is also the name of a Japanese IT/web consulting company, 株式会社インテルゲート, founded in 2012. ([intelgate.co.jp](https://intelgate.co.jp/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Other businesses/products with similar names** — search results also show a small software/digital solutions company called **INTELGATE** and similarly named products or companies, so the term is ambiguous. ([cy.linkedin.com](https://cy.linkedin.com/company/intelgate?utm_source=openai))
